records.source_span: A mayor of the former Carmel City
records.claim: Akram Hasson was a mayor of Carmel City.

records.source_span: Hasson entered the Knesset in May 2012
records.claim: Akram Hasson entered the Knesset in May 2012.

records.source_span: placed 35th on the Kadima list for the 2009 Knesset elections
records.claim: Akram Hasson was affiliated with Kadima party for the 2009 elections.

records.source_span: Placed eighth on the Kadima list for the 2013 elections, he lost his seat when the party was reduced to two MKs
records.claim: Akram Hasson lost his Knesset seat after the 2013 elections when Kadima was reduced to two seats.

records.source_span: After party leader Shaul Mofaz retired from politics on 27 January 2015; Hasson was elected on the same day to replace him, becoming the first Druze leader of a Jewish party
records.claim: Akram Hasson was elected Kadima party leader on 27 January 2015, becoming the first Druze leader of a Jewish party.

records.source_span: two days later he joined the new Kulanu list for the 2015 elections, being placed twelfth on the party list
records.claim: Akram Hasson joined Kulanu party for the 2015 elections on 29 January 2015.

records.source_span: Hasson returned to the Knesset in January 2016 as a replacement for party leader Moshe Kahlon, who had resigned under the Norwegian Law
records.claim: Akram Hasson returned to the Knesset in January 2016 as a replacement for Moshe Kahlon.
